messages:
ara: Heads-up — noticed a couple of UX/accessibility gaps in the API Keys drawer after the rotate flow. Quick recap and some suggestions. sophia (design): Ooo tell me. Screenshot / gif? :eyes: ara: gif attached in thread (not in this export). Main issues: copy-to-clipboard toast overlays the secret preview drawer, and screen readers don't announce success. Also the empty state CTA for 'Create key' feels buried when users hit revoke+rotate rapidly. mike (frontend): Got it. For the toast we currently render a floating snackbar at bottom-left. Easy to change placement, but need to avoid covering the secret drawer. Thoughts on moving it to top-right or making it inline? sophia (design): Top-right feels safer visually, but inline next to the key row might be clearer (less jumps). Inline would be ephemeral and tied to the element. Could also add a tiny spinner on copy to indicate action. lee (a11y): More important: we need an ARIA announcement when secret is revealed and when "copied" happens. Current DOM changes don't trigger a live region. Recommend adding an aria-live="polite" element with message: "API key copied to clipboard" and also announce if copy fails. mike (frontend): +1 for aria-live. Quick prototype: ```html
API key copied to clipboard
``` We can toggle the text when copy succeeds/fails. sam (security): Also flag security behavior: when rotating, the new key is only shown once. We must make copy/clipboard affordances super obvious and ensure no persistent DOM persists with the plaintext. If we add inline toasts, make sure they don't keep the secret in accessible tree after hide. ara: Design asks for a 'download .env' CTA after rotate — should that be gated behind an explicit acknowledgment? Some users expect a one-click download, others worry about accidental saving. sophia (design): Proposal: keep a single-show drawer showing the key + two CTAs: "Copy" and "Download (.env)". After either action, replace the plaintext with the token summary (last 4 chars) and show a soft banner: "Keep a secure copy — this key won't be shown again." Also add a small checkbox "I saved this key" that enables the Done button (optional, but helps reduce accidental loss). lee (a11y): Checkbox approach is okay but be careful — if users rely on assistive tech, forcing extra steps can be annoying. Make the checkbox non-required for keyboard users? I'd rather provide a clear visual and an aria-describedby to explain consequences, and let Done be available immediately. mike (frontend): Implementation notes: - Add aria-live region for copy success/failure. - Move snackbar to top-right for global notifications. - Inline confirmation element next to key row for context-only messages. - On reveal, attach a mutation observer to ensure the plaintext is removed from DOM after 30s or on blur. sam (security): We should never rely solely on JS timers for removal. If user navigates away, ensure session-level memory is wiped and server doesn't return plaintext again. Also audit that clipboard API usage doesn't leak to logs (we don't log clipboard contents but double-check). ara: One more UX nit: empty state for "API keys" page — when there are zero keys and user has org-level rotate policy enabled, we show a huge banner that duplicates the onboarding CTA. Could we condense that and move policy info into an accordion? sophia (design): Yes, compress the empty state. Show primary CTA "Create API key" and a secondary inline text "Organization rotation policy is on — keys will rotate every 90 days" with a link to policy details. Avoid two large CTAs stacked. lee (a11y): Ensure empty state uses semantic
and heading order, keyboard focus lands on CTA, and add an aria-live region for dynamic policy messages when toggled. ops-bot: deploy:staging started for branch keys/rotate-a11y-fixes by @mike at 2024-05-02T16:12:00Z mike (frontend): Thanks — I'll follow up with a PR that: moves global toast, adds aria-live region, ensures plaintext removed from DOM after action, and tweaks empty-state layout per design. Will ping for review when deployed to staging. ara: Awesome. Can we also add unit/integration tests for the copy flow? e2e that simulates failed clipboard should show accessible error. sophia (design): I'll update the spec doc with the new microcopy for toasts and the revised empty state. Will include accessible wording suggestions. sam (security): I'll run the brief audit once staging is up. Thanks team. :lock: ara: Thanks all — closing the thread. :white_check_mark:
